title: Explain the key and every wrong option
statement: Give every item an explanation that shows why its key is right and why each wrong option is wrong, rather than restating the answer.
detail: An AP item benchmark's judge asks whether an explanation teaches why the answer is correct and addresses why the other options are wrong, and fails one that just restates the answer (`icloud-work/incept/ap-benchmark-standalone/ap_benchmark/prompts/base.py`, lines 98-102). Its calibration set includes a failing case whose explanation is the answer repeated (`icloud-work/incept/ap-benchmark-standalone/ap_benchmark/calibration/gold_standard.json`, line 365). A reading generator stores a separate explanation for the right answer and for each distractor (`icloud-work/incept/sat-reading-generation/README.md`, lines 210-213). This is for when the answer is revealed; after a first wrong try, feedback says only where to look. Check in code that every item has an explanation.
against: Whether to explain each wrong option as well is contested. The local rubric asks '- Does it address why other options are wrong?' (`icloud-work/evaluator/ap_benchmark/prompts/base.py`, line 101). The later pipeline told the writer 'Prefer one concise explanation of why the keyed answer is correct instead of option-by-option rationales.' (`icloud-work/evaluatorML/.agent/memory/e2e_pipeline/iterate_repair_to_100.py`, line 194) and "- Do not use option-by-option explanation text; explain only the keyed answer's reasoning." (line 243). An explanation can itself be wrong: an answer letter that disagreed with its explanation failed 7 of 30 questions in a cross-check by another model ("This bug caused 7 out of 30 questions (23%) to fail", `icloud-work/ap-social-studies-generator/docs/archive/MCQ_BUG_HISTORY.md`, line 6), so each explanation needs its own consistency check. The value of an explanation is asserted in these files, not measured.

evidence.quote: - Does the explanation teach WHY the answer is correct?
- Does it address why other options are wrong?
- FAIL if explanation just restates the answer
"failure_reason": "Recall-only asking for date; explanation is just the answer repeated"

**Impact:** Students cannot learn from their mistakes without explanations
- Must explain why correct answer is correct
- Must explain why at least one wrong answer is wrong (for MCQ)
student: "Picks an option. A wrong pick sends them back to a line without naming the answer; the right pick shows the line that proves it.",
- feedback[i] is shown after option i is picked. Right option: one sentence that confirms it and quotes the line.
student: "Taps a line. A wrong line gets a hint; the right line is highlighted with the reason it proves the claim.",
- reveal: one sentence that explains how the line proves the claim.
Verdict: **the feedback lines are the best copy in the build** — declarative, one fact, no praise inflation, no exclamation marks, every wrong answer corrected with the reason.
All 5 first-read comprehension checks anchor their correct-answer feedback to a verbatim story quote (matches doc Component 5 Layer A/B house style: "Yes. '...' Read on.").
